repo.name: vibeBMS Nightly
repo.description: Nightly builds of vibeBMS, a BMS player: the latest build of the default branch of https://github.com/vibeBMS/vibe.

apps.description:
A cross-platform BMS player modelled on Lunatic Rave 2 and beatoraja: it plays
BMS, BME, BML, PMS and bmson charts with their judge and gauge rules, LR2 and
beatoraja skins, courses, replays and difficulty tables, with an on-screen
controller for touch screens.

This is the nightly build of the default branch: a new version comes with each
commit, and it is experimental on Android. It installs beside a stable build
(its own app id) and keeps its data in Android/data/io.github.vibebms.nightly/files:
copy BMS folders there over USB, or download songs a difficulty table lists in
the app's browser.
apps.name: vibeBMS Nightly
